---
name: Mod Documentation / Feature Request
about: Suggest a mod.io mod to catalog or a new tooling feature
title: "[REQUEST] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**Request Type**
- [ ] Document new mod.io mod in `Mods/subscribed/` & `Mods/subscribed/library.md`
- [ ] Tooling or CLI improvement
- [ ] New mod feature in `Mods/authored/`
- [ ] Agent skill enhancement

**Target Mod Information (if mod documentation request)**
- Mod Name:
- Mod.io URL / Mod ID:
- Category (Gear, Spells, Classes, Progression, Utilities):
- Key Features / Mechanics:

**Description & Motivation**
A clear and concise description of why this mod should be cataloged or why this feature should be implemented.

**Dependencies or Prerequisites**
Does this mod require Community Library, Compatibility Framework, UnlockLevelCurve, or Script Extender?

**Additional Context**
Add any other relevant details or links here.
